capabilities.note: WIDE: only A has a drag handle (cap-01e passes that narrow form).

capabilities.text: Drag a point off the circle and back on
capabilities.note: The A handle stays on the circle.

capabilities.text: Draw a line between any two chosen points, midpoints or touch points
capabilities.note: Built in batch 2, round 20 (2026-11-08). Lines are a fixed set tied to O, A, B; no line can be added between chosen points.

Draw a chord

Join a chord's midpoint to the center

capabilities.note: Built in batch 5, round 227 (2026-11-10). Lines stop at their points; no line-end parameter.

capabilities.text: A tangent at a point on the circle
capabilities.note: At A only.

capabilities.text: A tangent at any point on the circle, not only A
capabilities.note: Built in batch 2, round 21 (2026-11-08). WIDE: show_tangent draws the tangent at A only (cap-03a passes that narrow form).

capabilities.text: One or both tangents from a point outside the circle
capabilities.note: Built in batch 5, round 228 (2026-11-10). No outside point exists.

capabilities.text: Label an angle with typed text
capabilities.note: Built in batch 5, round 229 (2026-11-10). No angle-label text parameter.

capabilities.text: Congruence arcs on an angle
capabilities.note: Built in batch 5, round 230 (2026-11-10). No congruence-arc parameter.

capabilities.text: Label an arc in degrees
capabilities.note: Built in batch 5, round 232 (2026-11-10). arc highlights the arc but writes no measure on it.

capabilities.text: Label an arc by its length
capabilities.note: Built in batch 5, round 233 (2026-11-10). Arc length is only a row in the table below the figure (m_arc), not a label on the arc.

capabilities.text: Label an arc with typed text
capabilities.note: Built in batch 5, round 234 (2026-11-10). No arc-label text parameter.

capabilities.text: Congruence ticks on an arc
capabilities.note: Built in batch 5, round 235 (2026-11-10). No parameter.

capabilities.text: Draw an arc bold and in a colour, or leave it plain
capabilities.note: Checked by hand: the arc is drawn thick and purple.

capabilities.text: Label a line with its length
capabilities.note: Checked by hand: the chord is labelled AB = 7.07 cm; the radius label is r = 5 cm by default.

capabilities.text: Label any line with its length, not only the radius and chord
capabilities.note: Built in batch 5, round 237 (2026-11-10). WIDE: length labels come with the radius and chord only (cap-05f passes that narrow form).

capabilities.text: Label a line with typed text
capabilities.note: Built in batch 5, round 236 (2026-11-10). r_label offers Value, Letter only (a fixed r) or None; no typed text, and no labels for other lines.

capabilities.text: Congruence ticks on a line
capabilities.note: Built in batch 5, round 238 (2026-11-10). No parameter.

capabilities.note: Built in batch 5, round 239 (2026-11-10). No parameter.

capabilities.note: Built in batch 5, round 240 (2026-11-10). No per-line style parameter.

capabilities.note: Built in batch 5, round 243 (2026-11-10). Only O, A, B, C and M can be named.

capabilities.note: Built in batch 5, round 244 (2026-11-10). No parameter.
